name: Klarna
label: Klarna — Klarna Payments + Order Management
description: Official Klarna Payments + Order Management. Docs: https://docs.klarna.com. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets. BNPL. Consumer-credit disclosures. Klarna JS widget — no PAN. Config region is the official API hostname (api.klarna.com / api-na.klarna.com / api-oc.klarna.com or playground variants) substituted into baseUrl as https://{region}.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Klarna. Secrets never on this port. HARD PCI: cardholder data never enters the graph. Use processor tokens (pm_, nonce, encryptedCard, vault id) only. Never PAN, CVC, track data, or raw bank account numbers on INPUT/OUTPUT/logs. API keys are StudioQuack password secrets.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: session_create | order_get | order_capture | order_refund | trigger. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Klarna order id for order_get / order_capture / order_refund.

schema.label: purchase_country
schema.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. Official purchase_country for session_create. Example: US.

schema.label: order_lines
schema.description: Official order_lines [{name, quantity, unit_price, tax_rate, total_amount, type}]. session_create / capture / refund.

schema.label: captured_amount
schema.description: Capture amount minor units for order_capture.

schema.label: refunded_amount
schema.description: Refund amount minor units for order_refund.

schema.label: order_tax_amount
schema.description: Tax minor units. Official order_tax_amount for session_create.

schema.label: locale
schema.description: Klarna locale for session_create. Example: en-US.

schema.label: merchant_urls
schema.description: Official merchant_urls {confirmation, notification, push} for session_create.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: session_create | order_get | order_capture | order_refund | trigger. Default session_create. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Password
configurationParameters.description: Klarna credential (basic Authorization). StudioQuack secret. Never INPUT, never logged.

configurationParameters.label: Region
configurationParameters.description: Official Klarna API hostname (live EU/NA/OC or playground). Substituted into baseUrl as https://{region}.
